title: Published-IC reference arm: standard-base FGHR-symmetrised Weil/Gaudry descent with msolve F4 and WDSat, cold whole-solve in GAE
status_note: Specified 2026-10-24 (README, DRAFT PROTOCOL, INVENTORY, RECONCILIATION). One relation-level smoke on Koblitz n = 13, 15, 17 at m = 3 is in SMOKE_20261024.md; it is not a solve and not a claim. The protocol is not frozen. WDSat is not installed; pin 61c6ff3f49445af2729274819edb27b85a89efc1 (mtrimoska/WDSat, 2024-06-20). code.build names the smoke harness only; run.argv names examples/published_ic_ref_arm (milestone M5, not written).
blocked_on: note:M1 FGHR symmetrised S_{m+1} for random binary curves and m = 4: symmetrised_terms returns None for m >= 4 (src/cryptanalysis/koblitz_symmetrised.rs:414-443)
note:M2 msolve is not a SystemSolver (src/cryptanalysis/ic_framework/solvers.rs registry) and root extraction from the msolve basis is not built
note:M3 WDSat not installed or vendored; GPL-3.0, external process only; pin 61c6ff3f49445af2729274819edb27b85a89efc1
note:M6 GAE has no unit for an external process; docs/ic/calibration.json lacks Koblitz n = 43..61, random binary n = 13/19/37 and p^4
note:M8 no code for the p^5 FGHR symmetrisation or instance
hw:Linux host with Callgrind for Ir-priced msolve/WDSat (Valgrind does not run on this Apple-silicon host)

links.lead: ic-regime-review-20261024/REVIEW.md section 1 item 4, section 3 item 5, section 5.1 F2

question: At matched (family, n, m), what does the best published index-calculus pipeline (standard base, FGHR symmetrised, msolve F4 / WDSat) cost cold, whole-solve, one target, verified, in GAE, and how far is each lab producer from it?
decision_value: Turns every 'x times rho' in the program into an 'x times published' or shows that the published arm is itself far above rho at these n; prices the (4,6) Weil-descent cell against a published floor; fixes what the word baseline means in an external claim (RECONCILIATION.md).

resources.notes: Estimate for the run after build M1-M9 (predicted): binary n <= 27 cells are minutes; n = 37 and Koblitz 41..61 at m = 3, 4 dominate; 16 GB cap per run with did-not-complete rows recorded. Build is 45-75 engineer-days (INVENTORY section 3).

outputs.result_schema: one JSONL line per (cell, target): family, n, m, ell, base, solver, n_vars, relations, rank, msolve_ir or wdsat_ir, gae_S, rho_S, verified

cairn.notes: Two shards, each runnable only after its build milestones (INVENTORY section 3); none runnable today.

env.name: crypto-published-ic-ref
env.recipe: A rust image with the pinned crypto commit, msolve built from source, WDSat built at 61c6ff3f49445af2729274819edb27b85a89efc1 and valgrind on a Linux host; then cairn lab env import.

exec.sandbox_reason: external solvers (msolve, WDSat) run as child processes under Callgrind; jail limits untested

funding.rationale: Placeholder pending owner: the card is blocked on 45-75 engineer-days of build; it sets the external baseline every ratio is quoted against, so it is priced above a single heavy run but not at exponent-level.
